The trade is based around the idea of an Engulf into CP on the Daily so
my final target needs to be a daily target so it is the top of the CP up
 around 1.6750ish. However, I'm playing a FL that is only visible on

target so I can get to net BE in case IT decide they have more orders to
 fill before moving higher. I'm using my partial profit EA and I have
it set to 1.6321.
